_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Not knowing simple lines for shopping

items.en: Do you have a smaller size?
items.native: Apakah ada ukuran yang lebih kecil?

segments.text: Shopping in English? Here are four easy lines. Repeat after me.
Do you have a smaller size?

native.caption: Bingung saat belanja di luar negeri? Simpan 4 kalimat ini: “How much is this?”, “Do you have a smaller size?”, “Can I try it on?”, “I will take it.”. Dengarkan Ama, lalu ulangi saat jeda. Latihan lebih lanjut ada di aplikasi Lexkite.

en.caption: Confused when shopping abroad? Save these 4 lines: “How much is this?”, “Do you have a smaller size?”, “Can I try it on?”, “I will take it.”. Listen to Ama, then say each one in the pause. More practice is in the Lexkite app.
